title: Rectangular base
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and translation vector also set to zero. On the first face, draw the first loop consisting of four lines: start by drawing the first line from the origin (0.0, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.0), then draw the second line from (0.75, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.0155), followed by the third line from (0.75, 0.0155) to (0.0, 0.0155), and finally the fourth line from (0.0, 0.0155) back to the origin (0.0, 0.0). Apply a scale factor of 0.75 to the entire two-dimensional sketch. Since the Euler angles and translation vector are already set to zero, no additional transformation is needed. Extrude the scaled two-dimensional sketch along the normal direction by 0.0768 units, ensuring that the extrusion does not occur in the opposite direction. Define a boolean operation to create a new solid body from this extrusion. The final dimensions of the rectangular base will be 0.75 units in length, 0.0155 units in width, and 0.0768 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0, 0).lineTo(0.75, 0).lineTo(0.75, 0.0155).lineTo(0, 0.0155).close()

# Extrude the sketch
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.0768)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder

import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create a sketch on the XY plane
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0155) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0155) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch to create a rectangular section
r = r.extrude(0.0768)
